Banana Bread

A moist loaf that uses up spotty bananas.

Prep time: 15 minutes
Cook time: 1 hour
Total time: 1 hour 15 minutes
Makes 1 loaf
Calories: 280 kcal

Ingredients
3 ripe bananas
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/2 cup butter

Directions
1. Mash the bananas.
2. Stir in the flour and butter.
3. Bake for 1 hour.

Notes
Keeps three days wrapped.
